rules.dispatch: post-rewrite STRING_IN_REGEXP via rewriteMembership (r is re.++ with one str.to_re, no allchar, >=3 children, const not first/last)
rules.summary: x in (re.++ _* (str.to_re s) _*) --> (str.contains x s)
rules.guard_comparison: RARE matches exactly 3 children. C++ accepts >=3 children of (re.* allchar) plus one inner str.to_re, but adjacent _* _* are merged by RE concat normalization before membership is rewritten, so the only reachable shape is 3 children; s may be symbolic in both.
rules.guard_gap: Unnormalized (re.++ _* (str.to_re s) _* _*) would not match str-in-re-contains directly; unreachable through the rewriter and in any case reconstructed via a star-merge RARE step (probe).
rules.probe_result: cvc5=unsat z3=timeout; no trust; ethos correct on the 3-child proof (the nested one uses re-concat-star-subsume2, renamed at HEAD, so ethos cannot check it); allchar case stays sat
rules.rationale: RARE rule covers every reachable input.

rules.dispatch: post-rewrite STRING_IN_REGEXP via rewriteMembership (r is re.inter / re.union)
rules.summary: x in (re.union r1..rn) --> or of memberships; re.inter --> and
rules.guard_comparison: Fixed-point (define-rule*) RARE rules handle n-ary forms.
rules.probe_result: no trust; ethos correct
rules.rationale: Exact RARE.

rules.dispatch: post-rewrite STRING_IN_REGEXP via rewriteMembership (r is str.to_re)
rules.summary: (str.in_re x (str.to_re s)) --> (= x s)
rules.guard_comparison: Unconditional.
rules.probe_result: no trust; ethos correct
rules.rationale: Exact RARE.

rules.dispatch: post-rewrite STRING_IN_REGEXP via rewriteMembership (r is re.range and isConstRegExp(r))
rules.summary: x in (re.range c1 c2) --> (and (<= code c1 code x) (<= code x code c2))
rules.guard_comparison: C++ guard isConstRegExp -> utils::isCharacterRange (both constants of length 1); RARE condition (and (= (str.len c1) 1) (= (str.len c2) 1)). Identical. Empty x: code = -1 below range.
rules.probe_result: no trust; ethos correct
rules.rationale: Exact RARE with matching guard.

rules.dispatch: post-rewrite STRING_IN_REGEXP via rewriteMembership (r is re.comp)
rules.summary: (str.in_re x (re.comp R)) --> (not (str.in_re x R))
rules.guard_comparison: Unconditional.
rules.probe_result: no trust; ethos correct
rules.rationale: Exact RARE.

rules.dispatch: post-rewrite STRING_IN_REGEXP via rewriteMembership via rewriteViaStrInReConsume (after the kind-specific cases)
rules.summary: consume constant/identical parts of x against R; see STR_IN_RE_CONSUME
rules.guard_comparison: Same function as STR_IN_RE_CONSUME; see that record.
rules.probe_result: see STR_IN_RE_CONSUME: proofs no trust + ethos correct; 10 differential probes agree
rules.rationale: Independent verified Eunoia definition.

rules.dispatch: post-rewrite STRING_IN_REGEXP via rewriteMembership via rewriteViaMacroStrInReInclusion (last case)
rules.summary: (str.in_re x R) --> true by RE inclusion of x's generalized constant RE
rules.guard_comparison: Same function as MACRO_STR_IN_RE_INCLUSION; see that record.
rules.probe_result: no trust; ethos correct; negatives sat
rules.rationale: See MACRO_STR_IN_RE_INCLUSION.

rules.dispatch: post-rewrite SEQ_NTH via rewriteSeqNth
rules.summary: (seq.nth c i) for constant sequence c and constant 0<=i<|c| --> element; out-of-bounds left alone
rules.guard_comparison: C++ guard: i non-negative, fits unsigned, < len. SEQ_EVAL_OP's C++ side calls postRewrite (circular), but Eunoia seq-eval-op evaluates independently.
rules.probe_result: proof no trust (seq-eval-op), ethos correct; out-of-bounds/negative index stays unconstrained (sat, z3 agrees)
rules.rationale: Independent Eunoia evaluation.

rules.dispatch: post-rewrite SEQ_NTH via rewriteSeqNth (after SEQ_NTH_EVAL)
rules.summary: (seq.nth (seq.++ p (seq.unit x) q) n) --> x when n is 0 or stripSymbolicLength strips exactly n from the front (strict)
rules.guard_comparison: Relies on StringsEntail::stripSymbolicLength(strict) leaving curr syntactically 0 (checked inside; partial-constant strips keep the remainder as the head, which is then not a seq.unit). No RARE rule or theory rewrite captures the symbolic case; seq-nth-unit only matches a bare (seq.unit x) at 0.
rules.guard_gap: Whole rule except the trivial (seq.nth (seq.unit x) 0) instance.
rules.probe_result: proof probes cvc5=unsat z3=unsat with trust TRUST_THEORY_REWRITE e.g. (= (seq.nth (seq.++ s (seq.unit a) t) (seq.len s)) a); partial-constant-strip and wrong-offset differentials agree with z3
rules.rationale: Sound on every probe and by inspection of the strict strip, but nothing in the proof checks it.

rules.dispatch: post-rewrite STRING_CHARAT via rewriteCharAt, unconditional
rules.summary: (str.at x n) --> (str.substr x n 1)
rules.guard_comparison: Unconditional, same output.
rules.probe_result: no trust; ethos correct; negative/oob index edges agree with z3
rules.rationale: Exact RARE.
